name: The Codest brand
scope: Documents the current visual identity from the website design file. Not a rebrand. Copy and claims are governed by the content guide.

files.README.md: Entry point: what is here and where to start
files.AGENT_GUIDE.md: Rules and checklist for AI agents producing anything visual
files.visual-identity/guidelines.md: Visual Identity Guidelines: logo, colour, type, layout, signature outline, icons, waves, imagery, known issues
files.visual-identity/the-codest-visual-identi: Shareable PDF version of the guidelines (14 pages, A4 landscape)
files.visual-identity/guidelines-print.html: Source the PDF is printed from
files.design-system/README.md: How to build a page; tokens, states, every component and section with its Figma source
files.design-system/examples.html: All components rendered on one page
files.design-system/tokens/tokens.json: Source of truth for every value
files.design-system/tokens/tokens.css: Generated CSS variables, font faces and type classes
files.design-system/components/bundle.js: 70 React 18 components on window.Codest (building blocks, cards, sections, navigation)
files.design-system/components/bundle.css: Base component styles on token variables
files.design-system/assets/logo/the-codest-log: Logo for white and pale backgrounds
Logo for navy and dark photo backgrounds
files.design-system/assets/patterns/wave-lines: Line wave texture (hero, case panels), navy at 8%
files.design-system/components/sections.css: Interaction states, page sections, layout helpers, responsive rules
files.design-system/templates/landing-page.htm: Reference landing page following the Figma Home page, built only from the system
files.design-system/templates/service-page.htm: Reference service/campaign page following the Figma PHP service page
files.design-system/assets/patterns/wave-banne: White wave lines for navy banner boxes
files.design-system/assets/patterns/wave-case-: Wave texture for case study panels
files.design-system/assets/graphics/areas-info: Areas-of-expertise graphic: technology circles on the brand gradient
files.design-system/assets/graphics/world-map@: World map with project countries in pink
